note: Wording successors for the scratch core v97 on published v96. Variant q: the five input questions that share the Schedule 1 lines 2a-6 sentence. Variant qf: q plus the Schedule 1 line 10 guard sentence.

replacements.old: In 2025, did you receive alimony, or have income or loss from a business, a farm, rental property or royalties, a partnership, S corporation or trust, or any other gain or loss reported on Schedule 1 lines 2a through 6?
replacements.new: In 2025, did you receive alimony, or have income or loss from a business, a farm, rental property or royalties, a partnership, S corporation or trust, or any other gain or loss reported on Schedule 1 lines 2a through 6? Also answer yes if a Form 1099-B you received shows an amount above zero in box 13 (Bartering), even if you do not think of it as a business.

replacements.old: No value is published because a completeness or guard condition is not satisfied.
replacements.new: Schedule 1 line 10 has no value because one of these is true: your Form 1099-G or Form 1099-K statements are not confirmed complete, or you said you have Schedule 1 income this return does not compute (alimony; business income, including an amount in box 13 (Bartering) of a Form 1099-B; other gains; rental, royalty, partnership, S corporation or trust income; farm income; other income on lines 8a through 8z; a state or local tax refund; another Form 1099-G payment; or an unemployment repayment). Your total income is not shown, so that income is not left out.
